## Project 01: DUANGDOCTOR
Category: AI Product / Astrology
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, Next.js 16, Claude API, TypeScript
Scale: 8,621 lines, 12 modules
Duration: 40 hours

### What It Is
An AI fortune teller that reads your chart across five ancient traditions simultaneously — Thai astrology, Chinese BaZi, Western zodiac, Chinese zodiac, and Pythagorean numerology — then cross-references them against each other to find where multiple systems point in the same direction. You give it a birth date. The calculation layer computes everything — four pillars, thaksa wheels, ten gods, luck cycles, shen sha stars, numerology paths, zodiac profiles — and hands the LLM a complete pre-computed chart with structured tradition docs to reason over. The model doesn't calculate. It interprets, cross-references, and synthesizes.

### Technical Details
- Next.js 16 (App Router, server components, API routes)
- Claude API (Anthropic SDK) with adaptive thinking and agentic tool_use
- TypeScript end-to-end — 8,621 lines
- 12-module astrology engine: 1,103 lines of deterministic computation
- 7 Claude tool_use definitions (auto-generated from config JSON)
- 7,194-word Thai astrology wiki from traditional sources
- Security: rate limiting (100 calls/hr/IP), daily budget cap ($5/day), prompt injection guards

### Key Achievement
Computationally grounded multi-tradition astrology. Same chart for the same birthday every time, verifiable against traditional tables. Three traditions independently agreeing is a signal, not a horoscope.

## Project 02: LLM WIKI
Category: Tool / Knowledge Base
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Obsidian, Git
Scale: 120+ wiki pages
Duration: 10 hours (6 sessions)

### What It Is
An implementation of Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern — LLMs building and maintaining structured knowledge bases from plain markdown, navigating by index and wikilinks instead of vector similarity search. Drop a source in, the agent reads it, breaks it into concept and entity pages, links them together, updates the index, and logs what it did.

### Technical Details
- Three-layer architecture: raw/ (immutable sources), wiki/ (LLM-generated pages), CLAUDE.md (schema)
- Three core operations: Ingest, Query, Lint
- Serving via Anthropic prompt caching — ~5x cheaper per turn than traditional RAG
- 31 raw sources ingested across Thai, Chinese, and English
- Self-healing lint system that caught a critical doctrinal error

### Key Achievement
Zero infrastructure knowledge management. Markdown files in a git repo. Accumulating intelligence — each source makes every future query better.

## Project 03: CONTENT ENGINE
Category: Tool / Video Pipeline
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, FFmpeg, Python, Click + Rich
Resolution: 1080x1920 (vertical)
Duration: 10 hours

### What It Is
A production pipeline that turns a creative brief into a finished, beat-synced short-form video. No editing software. No timeline dragging. Takes raw inputs — images, audio, a script — and assembles them into publish-ready vertical video with animated subtitles, text overlays, transitions, and multi-layer audio mixing. Every cut lands on the beat.

### Technical Details
- FFmpeg video assembler with transitions, text overlays, 3-layer audio mixing
- Beat detection via RMS onset analysis (no external libraries)
- ASS subtitle generator with 7 animation types
- CLI built on Click and Rich, SQLite database, YAML configuration
- Operated through natural language via Claude Code

### Key Achievement
One person can produce short-form content at team speed without learning editing software.

## Project 04: PHUKET PRIVATE EXPERIENCE
Category: Design / Landing Page
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, Vite, React, Framer Motion, Tailwind
Scale: 1,250 lines, 10 components
Duration: 10 hours

### What It Is
A single-page marketing site for an invitation-only luxury lifestyle brand in Phuket, Thailand. High-ticket experiences ($8K-$150K+) for ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Dark cinematic luxury with spring physics animations.

### Technical Details
- Vite 5.4 + React 18.3 + Framer Motion 11.15 + Tailwind CSS 3.4
- Spring physics animations (stiffness 80, damping 20)
- Magnetic CTA button with cursor tracking
- Parallax hero with scroll-driven opacity
- Production build: 94KB gzipped
- Anti-pattern design system (taste skills/) banning generic AI-generated UI patterns

### Key Achievement
Agency-quality luxury page built by one person. Dark-to-cream section transition signals psychological shift from desire to action.

## Project 05: JRPG BAZI LOADOUT
Category: Web App / Interaction Design
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, React 18, Babel Standalone, CSS
Resolution: 1920x1080 (fixed canvas)
Duration: 20 hours

### What It Is
A JRPG-styled web application rendering Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) charts as an immersive character-loadout screen. NieR: Automata and Persona 5 inspired. Bilingual Japanese/Chinese/English with real-time toggling.

### Technical Details
- React 18 with zero build tooling (Babel standalone)
- WebAudio API synthesized UI sounds (no audio files)
- 4 color themes (Crimson, Indigo, Gold, Ice)
- 5-step cinematic onboarding sequence
- Atomic design system: Panel, Selectable, CornerNotches, StatBar, BiLabel, Tooltip
- ~2,000 lines of hand-written JSX and CSS, zero dependencies

### Key Achievement
Astrology as game UI. Every piece of chart data is touchable, hoverable, and responsive with particle effects and synthesized audio.

## Project 06: MAISON D'ARGENT
Category: Design / Editorial Landing
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, React 18, Babel Standalone, CSS
Scale: ~2,000 lines, 5 files
Duration: 10 hours

### What It Is
A magazine-grade editorial landing page for a fictional luxury lifestyle society. Old money aesthetics, private club exclusivity, and print-editorial typography in the browser.

### Technical Details
- 4 color palettes (Bone & Ink, Sepia & Antique, Cream & Bordeaux, Ink dark mode)
- 4 typographic pairings with semantic display/body/label/mono layers
- 4 masthead treatments with distinct editorial voices
- 9 hand-drawn SVG service icons as line engravings
- CSS-only paper grain texture (resolution-independent)
- Full 15+ field membership form styled as editorial content
- ~2,000 lines, zero dependencies beyond React + Babel

### Key Achievement
Density of print in the browser. Nothing looks like a website — everything looks typeset.

## Project 07: PORTFOLIO.EXE
Category: Web App / Design System
Date: 2026.04
Tools: Claude Code, React 18, Babel Standalone, CSS
Scale: 2,182 lines, 11 files
Duration: 20 hours

### What It Is
This portfolio itself — a terminal-aesthetic React app that doubles as a project tracker. Navigate it like software with keyboard shortcuts, a boot sequence, and a works database you browse like a file system.

### Technical Details
- 4 color themes (Cream, Ash, Rust, Mono) with 15+ CSS custom properties each
- 4 font pairings switchable via data-font attribute
- 3 density modes (Compact, Normal, Spacious)
- CRT effects: scanlines, film grain, vignette (all adjustable)
- Glitch text with chromatic aberration
- Boot sequence animation
- WASD keyboard navigation
- Tweaks panel (Ctrl+Shift+.) for live customization
- 2,182 lines across 11 files, zero build step

### Key Achievement
Game design principles applied to portfolio presentation. Every panel, token, and interaction is part of a coherent system.
